children: MercadoLibre entered into an underwriting agreement for a $1.0 billion offering of 5.850% Notes due 2036 to raise long-term capital. The underwriters agreed to purchase the notes, which are guaranteed by key MercadoLibre subsidiaries across Latin America. Proceeds are expected to support general corporate purposes and enhance the company’s financial flexibility.
: Underwriting agreement for $1.0 billion 5.850% senior notes due 2036
: BofA Securities, Citigroup Global Markets, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan Securities and Morgan Stanley, as representatives of the underwriters
: Raise long-term capital and enhance financial flexibility
